proposal.reason: Primary change is a substantive overhaul of the IB network transport/proxy path: connect/accept handshake state machine and ready signaling, QoS traffic-class/service-level handling, ECE negotiation, FLID/GRH routing behavior, receive-size reporting semantics, and MR registration cache ownership/cleanup across net_ib, net.cc, proxy, and ibv wrappers. Added gin because the PR also makes independent GIN backend behavior changes (traffic-class normalization/validation, GIN IB/GDAKI connect flow using the new IB connect/abort path, and GIN-specific error cleanup) that require GIN module expertise beyond incidental caller wiring.
